_comment: First matching rule wins. match keys: proto (http|raw), dst (original IPv4), port, host (regex on Host header), path (regex; named groups usable in respond.file and respond.body), body (http only: regex searched in the request body, case-insensitive; named groups usable likewise). respond for http: status, body ({name} placeholders take the named groups), file (relative to /srv/sandbox/serve), type, headers. respond for raw: action (hold|close), timeout, banner, send_hex.

rules.name: example dropper host: serve staged files for any path
example C2-style port: hold and log (never sends commands)

dns._comment: names: regex -> IPv4 for A queries (first match wins); nx: list of name regexes answered NXDOMAIN (checked first, any query type); default: everything else. Pointing a name at a specific address lets IP-based rules above match it.

_stun_comment: stun: answer STUN Binding Requests on any UDP address/port with the client's address (default true).
